data.exact_reserve_text: Estimate of cumulative gross claims incurred: At end of underwriting year 246,704, One year later 642,640, Two years later 672,210.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a strengthening of prior year reserves amounting to GBP 29.57 million, primarily attributable to the 2016 underwriting year. This movement was calculated from the gross claims development table, showing an increase in the estimated ultimate claims for that year. The report also notes a reinsurance-to-close (RITC) transaction for all earned 2015 and prior business, which significantly reduced gross claims outstanding but is a transfer of liabilities rather than a re-estimation of reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: The estimation of reserves is subject to uncertainty due to the fact that the settlement of claims that have arisen before the balance sheet date is dependent on future events and developments, as well as the latency and late reporting of claims.

Unforeseen loss trends resulting from court rulings, changes in the law, differences in loss adjustment practice, medical and long-term care, and economic factors such as inflation can have a considerable impact on run-off results.
Expected loss ratios are a key assumption in the estimate of ultimate losses for business at an early stage of development.
Assumed loss development patterns are another significant assumption in estimating the loss reserves.
data.data_quality_notes: The reinsurance-to-close (RITC) transaction for 2015 and prior business in January 2018 significantly impacts the reported claims outstanding figures, making it difficult to isolate traditional prior year development for those years. The prior year development figure is derived from the 2016 underwriting year's movement in the gross claims development table, as 2016 business was not part of the RITC transfer.
